notes_for_editor: No build date, design, staffing or removal date found for the tower. Agency comes from the photo record and the Forest Lookouts page; the 2011 tower list has no TFS tag for Tenaha. FFLA coordinates 31.81267, -93.95071 are about 60 m from the 2011 list point, so the story gives no point. The photo URL is the og:image of the SFASU record; the image itself was not viewed, so check it renders before use. The Forest Lookouts site spells the name TENEHA; the story now gives that spelling. The story's first sentence cites the photo record (source 2) and the 2011 list (source 4) for the tower's name, which the Handbook entry alone does not support.
